object: 3D transformable mechanical metamaterials with engineered zero modes
problem: How can zero modes be systematically engineered to give reversible transformation between solid-like and gas-like metamaterial states?
mechanism_or_method: 3D metamaterial design with engineered zero modes realizing seven extremal types, verified on 3D-printed TPU prototypes with tunable wave manipulation.
limitation: Only demonstrated on printed TPU prototypes; extension to other physical domains is speculative.
decision_relevance: Guides design of reconfigurable metamaterials with switchable stiffness and wave response.

problem: How can electroadhesives combine compliance, self-healing and strong adhesion for soft robot grippers?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamically crosslinked ionic organohydrogel electrodes with high-permittivity polyurethane dielectric, supramolecular bonding, additively manufactured into grippers.
limitation: Lab-scale grippers; durability and performance under varied environments not established.
decision_relevance: Informs material choice for low-voltage electroadhesive grippers.

problem: Which parameter controls fracture resistance in cubic-B1 refractory high-entropy carbides?
mechanism_or_method: Nanoindentation crack statistics combined with ab initio molecular dynamics under tension; VEC above about 9.4 activates transformation plasticity.
limitation: Limited to cubic-B1 carbide compositions; correlation validated on few compositions.
decision_relevance: Selects carbide compositions by VEC for toughness.

object: self-protecting soft fluidic robots with electrohydrodynamic pumps
problem: How can soft fluidic robots gain fast untethered actuation, self-healing and intelligent self-protection?
mechanism_or_method: Integrate soft electrohydrodynamic pumps, actuators, a healing electrofluid and multifunctional E-skins to trigger self-protection behaviors.
limitation: Lab prototypes; long-term healing cycles and operating voltage constraints not addressed.
decision_relevance: Informs integrated pump-actuator-skin design for damage-tolerant soft robots.

problem: How do multielement iron- and platinum-group HEA atomic layers perform for hydrogen evolution and oxidation?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize ten quinary square-lattice HEA atomic layers; operando XAS, DFT and in situ electron microscopy reveal cocktail effect and phase transformations.
limitation: Catalyst stability tested only at lab scale; synthesis not shown scalable.
decision_relevance: none

object: magnetic-driven folded diaphragm soft robot drivers
problem: How can a single-piece magnetic folded diaphragm give large bidirectional deformation under a low homogeneous field?
mechanism_or_method: One-piece-mold folded diaphragm with radial magnetization segments; applied to diaphragm pump, earthworm crawler and squid-like swimmer.
limitation: Needs external magnetic field generation; only laboratory-scale demonstrations.
decision_relevance: Offers magnetic diaphragm drivers for untethered soft robots and pumps.

object: Chlorella pyrenoidosa microalgae coated with metal-organic frameworks
problem: Can MOF assembly on microalgae surfaces raise photosynthetic CO2 fixation efficiency without genetic modification?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assemble MOFs on algae to concentrate CO2 and convert it to transportable HCO3- at the bio-organic interface.
limitation: Lab culture only; long-term algal viability and scale-up unaddressed.
decision_relevance: none

object: soft self-contained grippers for UAV manipulation
problem: How can a lightweight self-adaptive voltage-driven soft gripper enable powerful UAV manipulation?
mechanism_or_method: U-shaped soft eccentric circular tube actuators driven by liquid-gas phase transition, cross-arranged into tendril- and hook-inspired grippers.
limitation: Phase-transition actuation likely slow and energy hungry; outdoor flight performance unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides gripper choice for aerial manipulation without precise positioning.

object: transparent glass surface integrating triboelectric nanogenerator and radiative cooler
problem: Can one glass surface harvest raindrop energy and radiatively cool in sunny weather?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent triboelectric layers doubling as thermal emitters, radiative cooling structure optimized with an evolutionary algorithm.
limitation: Small-scale device; outdoor durability and large-area manufacturing not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs multifunctional window coatings for energy harvesting and cooling.

object: liquid-infused Cu nanowire array thermal interface material
problem: How can interface thermal resistance be pushed below 1 mm2 K/W while keeping reliability?
mechanism_or_method: Soft double-sided Cu nanowire scaffold infused with thermal-bridge liquid metal that suppresses contact resistance.
limitation: Tested on chip-cooling and thermal cycling benches, not long-term in deployed systems.
decision_relevance: Selects thermal interface materials for high-power chip cooling.

problem: How can multiple microjoints be integrated at micrometer scale for many deformation modalities?
mechanism_or_method: Two-in-one femtosecond laser writing of hydrogel and metal nanoparticle microjoints with independent and linked joint control.
limitation: Microscale proof of concept requiring femtosecond laser fabrication; payload and throughput small.
decision_relevance: none

object: continuous fiber reinforced liquid crystal elastomer composites
problem: Can 4D printing of LCE with continuous fibers give aligned actuation, high force and energy absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Fiber-resin relative motion during printing creates shear that aligns mesogens; printing path programs folding and electrically driven morphing.
limitation: Thermal actuation needs elevated temperature; fatigue life not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Selects printing parameters for programmable actuating composite structures.

problem: How can wearable haptics stay accurate and comfortable despite sweat and moisture accumulation?
mechanism_or_method: Fully integrated stretchable breathable bioadhesive textile with 128 actuation pixels across the palm.
limitation: Small-scale user validation; long-term wear durability not established.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can hydrogels reach tendon-surpassing strength and toughness with swelling resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon dots act as nanofillers and nucleating agents inducing crystalline domains and oriented dense networks via pinning effect.
limitation: Underwater long-term mechanical stability and fatigue not shown; mechanism inferred indirectly.
decision_relevance: none

object: freestanding 4D printed continuous fiber LCE composites
problem: How can freestanding 3D deformable load-bearing LCE structures be printed rather than planar ones?
mechanism_or_method: Direct ink writing with continuous fibers supporting freestanding structure; off-center fiber distribution programs bending deformation.
limitation: Actuation requires heating to about 150 C; cyclic durability unreported.
decision_relevance: Guides fiber placement to program spatial deformation and load capacity.

problem: How can light-driven microrobots self-assemble reversibly and degrade pesticide pollutants?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal hematite microparticles coated by ALD TiO2; phoretic attraction under light and H2O2, magnetic dipole chaining in dark.
limitation: Requires H2O2 fuel and lab conditions; real water matrices untested.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can erythritol supercooling be stabilized for long-term seasonal solar thermal storage?
mechanism_or_method: Add carrageenan to raise solid-liquid interfacial energy, locking latent heat below -30 C; ultrasonication releases it.
limitation: Small-sample lab tests; storage durations and cycling over seasons not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Selects stabilized PCM formulations for seasonal heat storage in cold regions.

problem: Can contact electrification drive CO2 reduction to CO from ambient air at high efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: TENG of electrospun PVDF with Cu single-atom carbon nitride and quaternized cellulose nanofibers capturing CO2 for electron transfer.
limitation: Low absolute yield and lab-scale conditions; practical air-flow operation untested.
decision_relevance: none

object: atomically thin high-entropy oxide anode catalysts for PEM electrolysis
problem: Can naked metal ion self-assembly yield stable Ru-based high-entropy oxide anodes for acidic water electrolysis?
mechanism_or_method: Air-molten salt interface assembly and oxidation of 1 nm RuIrFeCoCrO2; Cr weakens Ru-O covalency improving stability.
limitation: Stability shown for hundreds of hours only, below commercial lifetimes; scale-up unaddressed.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can adhesives adapt to surfaces and switch attachment/detachment at millisecond speed?
mechanism_or_method: Contact-state sensing triggers magnetorheological stiffness tuning for conformal contact, shape locking and active release.
limitation: Needs magnetic field and sensing hardware; performance on rough or wet surfaces unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs switchable adhesive design for high-speed robotic gripping.

problem: How can recrystallized Mo achieve room-temperature superplasticity despite grain boundary brittleness?
mechanism_or_method: Ultralow grain boundary oxygen, soft texture and low angle boundaries via powder metallurgy, Y-type hot rolling and annealing, enabling dislocation transmission.
limitation: Single processing route and material; transfer to other refractory metals only proposed.
decision_relevance: Guides processing of ductile refractory metals by controlling grain boundary oxygen.

problem: Can degraded NCM and LMO cathodes be upcycled to low-cobalt 5 V cathodes without extra precursors?
mechanism_or_method: Subtractively extract equal Co and Ni, convert remaining metals to carbonate precursor for LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4-like spinel with in-situ Co doping.
limitation: Lab-scale recycling of model materials; real black mass heterogeneity only briefly addressed.
decision_relevance: none

object: transition metal sulfide sorbents for elemental mercury
problem: How can the mercury accommodation capacity of non-CuS transition metal sulfides be raised?
mechanism_or_method: In situ acid etching creates defective surfaces and pore structure promoting Hg0 adsorption and diffusion, giving over 100-fold enhancement.
limitation: Lab sorbent tests; performance in real flue gas conditions not shown.
decision_relevance: none

object: soft robotic shape display with electrohydraulic cells
problem: How can a shape display combine high-speed actuation, embedded sensing and control at scale?
mechanism_or_method: 10x10 array of cells integrating electrohydraulic soft actuators, magnetic sensing and control circuitry reaching 50 Hz morphing.
limitation: Requires high-voltage drive and complex fabrication; resolution limited to 10x10 cells.
decision_relevance: Informs integration of actuators and sensors in soft shape-morphing arrays.

problem: How can self-healing ion-based skins achieve very high fracture strength and toughness?
mechanism_or_method: Orthogonal dynamic crosslinks, aromatic disulfide and UPy moieties, in polymer and ionic conductor giving 34 MPa strength and autonomous healing.
limitation: Long-term healing cycles and environmental stability of ionic liquid not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How do support acidity and topology govern Cu redox and transfer in low-temperature NH3-SCR?
mechanism_or_method: Operando EPR, kinetic measurements and DFT show weaker Bronsted acidity hinders Cu(NH3)4 hydrolysis and Cu migration between cages.
limitation: Limited to a few zeolite topologies and lab conditions.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can an adhesive build strong underwater adhesion spontaneously without external pressing?
mechanism_or_method: Amphiphilic copolymer swollen with hydrophobic ionic liquid; water-induced functional group rearrangement raises adhesion energy to 458 J/m2.
limitation: Tested on PET substrate; 24 h build-up time and other substrates unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs adhesive selection for underwater bonding without clamping.

object: perfluorinated covalent triazine framework proton conductors
problem: Can low-temperature synthesis give CTFs with high proton conductivity?
mechanism_or_method: Direct cyclotrimerization of aromatic aldehyde with ammonium iodide; fluorine hydrogen-bonding with H3PO4 gives 0.182 S/cm at 150 C.
limitation: Relies on H3PO4 loading; durability in operating fuel cells not shown.
decision_relevance: none

object: modular uniformly thick origami-inspired deployable structures
problem: How can metre-scale deployable origami structures be made adaptable and capable of carrying large loads?
mechanism_or_method: Derive conditions for flat-foldable, developable, uniformly thick degree-N vertices; build modular structures with multi-path folding.
limitation: Prototype demonstrations; long-term civil deployment, joints durability and cost not established.
decision_relevance: Enables adaptable load-carrying deployable structures in civil design.

object: ultramicroporous 3D covalent organic frameworks for ethylene purification
problem: Can tuning pore environment improve C2H6/C2H4 separation in 3D COFs?
mechanism_or_method: Isostructural pyridine-containing 3D-TPP-COF adds C-H...N interactions with ethane, giving 110.4 cm3/g uptake and selectivity 1.8.
limitation: Selectivity is modest at 1.8; cycling and humid stability not discussed.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can metamaterial cells be designed to program crack paths and toughen like natural materials?
mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning design engine generates cells with microfibers producing crack bowing, deflection, shielding and bridging, raising fracture energy up to 1235%.
limitation: Abstract does not state experimental validation; training data generated by simulation.
decision_relevance: Guides cell design for damage-tolerant lightweight lattice structures.

object: Drosophila wing imaginal disc and its extracellular matrix
problem: How does differential growth anisotropy between epithelium and ECM shape a developing organ?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanical bilayer model capturing elasticity and ECM growth anisotropy; MMP2 expression controls ECM growth anisotropy.
limitation: Specific to Drosophila wing disc; generality to other organs not shown.
decision_relevance: none

object: liquid crystal elastomer vitrimers with tunable actuation temperature
problem: How can the actuation temperature of a fully crosslinked LCE be tuned after synthesis?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic covalent bond exchange in covalently adaptable LC networks preserves annealing-set isotropization temperatures reversibly.
limitation: Demonstrated on specific LC vitrimer chemistry; actuator cycling stability not described.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How does inorganic surface chemistry change epoxy structure and fracture behavior near adhesive interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Sub-nm smooth Si surfaces with OH or H terminations; probe amine-to-epoxy ratio, crosslinking and adhesion energy at the interface.
limitation: Model smooth silicon substrates; real rough or metal adherends may differ.
decision_relevance: Guides surface treatment choice to control adhesive failure mode.

problem: Can ML using fuel, ignition and observed fire data predict actual fire activity better than fire-weather danger indices?
mechanism_or_method: Data-driven models trained on global fuel evolution and fire detection datasets reduce false alarms of high-danger forecasts.
limitation: Skill depends on quality of input fuel and fire-detection data.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can text-derived processing descriptions plus alloy descriptors improve deep-learning prediction of pitting potential?
mechanism_or_method: Automated NLP converts textual experimental descriptions into network inputs; physics-based elemental descriptors replace compositions to identify key features.
limitation: Accuracy limited by literature-derived, heterogeneous data; no new alloys tested in abstract.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes alloy descriptors for corrosion-resistant composition screening.

problem: How can mechanical computing avoid inefficient memory access and signal propagation limits?
mechanism_or_method: Computing within an interaction network of mechanical memory units; 3D printed binary neural network, self-learning perceptron and all 16 two-input logic gates.
limitation: Small-scale printed demonstrators; speed and scalability of mechanical computation unaddressed.
decision_relevance: none

object: magnetic Janus origami robot for droplets
problem: How can one robot manipulate droplets across nanoliter to microliter scales?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetically actuated Janus origami robot with photothermal property for transport, splitting, dispensing, stirring, heating and PCR nucleic acid extraction.
limitation: Requires external magnetic actuation setup; throughput and robustness for real samples unclear.
decision_relevance: none

problem: Can an azole bearing seven nitro groups be synthesized with high density and positive oxygen balance?
mechanism_or_method: Stepwise nitration of 3,5-dimethylpyrazole yields 4-nitro-3,5-bis(trinitromethyl)-1H-pyrazole with density 2.04 g/cm3.
limitation: Thermal stability is a known concern; performance values partly calculated.
decision_relevance: none

problem: Can electrohydraulic artificial muscles reach mammalian-muscle performance at much lower driving voltage?
mechanism_or_method: Hydraulically amplified low-voltage electrostatic (HALVE) actuators reach 50.5 W/kg and 971 %/s at 1100 V, waterproof and self-clearing.
limitation: Still needs about 1100 V; lifetime and integrated untethered power not fully shown.
decision_relevance: Informs actuator choice and driver electronics for untethered soft robots.

object: polymer robotic fiber for minimally invasive surgery
problem: Can a thin scalable fiber robot give precise flexible-tool steering for endoscopic surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Thermally actuated fiber by local side heating, made by fiber drawing; control algorithms with endoscopic instruments tested in porcine laparoscopy.
limitation: Single porcine in vivo demonstration; thermal safety margins and human translation remain open.
decision_relevance: none

problem: What physically drives solvent flow through OSN membranes: diffusion or pressure-driven flow?
mechanism_or_method: Extended Flory-Rehner theory, nonequilibrium molecular dynamics and solvent transport experiments show pressure-driven cluster migration through pores.
limitation: Validated for limited membranes and solvents; generality across polymers uncertain.
decision_relevance: Shifts OSN membrane design from diffusion models to solvent affinity and pore structure.

object: graphite nanosheets at cryogenic temperature friction interfaces
problem: Can molecular rolling lubrication be realized through self-curling of graphite nanosheet edges?
mechanism_or_method: Cryogenic edge self-curling from uneven atomic shrinkage stress forms nanorollers under shear, observed experimentally and explained by simulations.
limitation: Requires cryogenic temperature and vacuum; relevance to ambient engineering contacts unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests graphite lubrication strategy for cryogenic vacuum tribological components.

object: laser powder bed fusion NiTi shape memory alloys
problem: How can additively manufactured NiTi gain simultaneous strength, ductility and stable superelasticity?
mechanism_or_method: Tailored heat treatment creates high-density Ni-rich local chemical inhomogeneity entities in B2 matrix that resist slip and relieve stress at pores.
limitation: Specific alloy and process window; fatigue life and geometry dependence not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides heat treatment for printed superelastic NiTi components.

object: soft robotic hand with tactile palm
problem: How can high-density palm tactile sensing coordinate with soft fingers to improve grasping and perception?
mechanism_or_method: Compact visual-tactile palm with fiber-reinforced two-segment pneumatic fingers and palm-finger feedback strategies, augmented by AI.
limitation: Laboratory tasks only; robustness in unstructured environments not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides sensor placement and palm-finger coordination in soft hand design.

problem: What determines columnar-to-equiaxed grain transition on solute addition in AM titanium alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Computational scheme comparing growth restriction factor with freezing range under rapid cooling; the freezing range mechanism predicts morphology more reliably.
limitation: Tested on limited Ti alloy systems and two AM approaches.
decision_relevance: Selects solute additions to obtain equiaxed grains in printed Ti alloys.

problem: Can homogeneous hydrogels self-reverse deformation under constant light illumination?
mechanism_or_method: Two coexisting spiropyrans with sequential descending-ascending charge variation drive macroscopic contraction then expansion, enabling self-regulated rolling.
limitation: Transient reversal in small films; slow hydrogel response and reproducibility over cycles unclear.
decision_relevance: none

object: Sn-Ag-Cu solder joints in BGA packages
problem: How does solder microstructure control thermal fatigue damage in electronic joints?
mechanism_or_method: EBSD mapping of thermally cycled joints interpreted with multi-scale modelling linking package-scale continuum to crystal plasticity finite element models.
limitation: Accelerated thermal cycling on specific alloy and package geometry; field service lives not compared.
decision_relevance: Guides solder joint microstructure design for thermal fatigue resistance.

problem: Can COF membranes with solvent-responsive flexibility give precise molecular sieving in organic solvents?
mechanism_or_method: Interlayer shifting in polar organic solvents creates selective sub-nanopores, giving over 99% rejection and permeance above 15 kg/m2/h/bar.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and scale-up not addressed.
decision_relevance: none

problem: How can strength and uniform ductility both be doubled in a maraging alloy?
mechanism_or_method: Deformable semi-coherent matrix precipitates plus grain-boundary precipitates dynamically transforming into matrix-type precipitates for work hardening.
limitation: Demonstrated on one model alloy; scalability and fatigue or fracture toughness not discussed.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy design for ultrahigh strength with retained ductility.

problem: How can vibrational imaging sensitivity be pushed beyond the millimolar shot-noise limit of SRS?
mechanism_or_method: Probe refractive index change from vibrational relaxation heating with a laser beam, giving over 500-fold modulation depth boost.
limitation: Requires custom optical setup; quantitative sensitivity limits across samples not specified.
decision_relevance: none

object: global steel and cement supply under carbon budgets
problem: Can steel and cement supply within Paris-compliant carbon budgets meet expected 2050 demand given infrastructure deployment uncertainty?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario analysis of feasible supply with uncertain deployment of CCS, renewable electricity and green hydrogen infrastructure.
limitation: Results depend on scenario assumptions about infrastructure deployment and baseline demand.
decision_relevance: none

object: waffle-shaped solar evaporator for seawater desalination
problem: How can interfacial solar evaporators avoid salt crystallization fouling during long-term operation?
mechanism_or_method: Waffle sidewalls trigger convection via solute and thermal Marangoni effects for spontaneous salt rejection; zinc-assisted pyrolysis of biomass carbon.
limitation: Tested in lab brine for 60 days; outdoor variable sunlight and scale-up untested.
decision_relevance: Informs evaporator geometry for salt-rejecting solar desalination.

problem: Can template-free synthesis give 2D single-crystal mesoporous HEOs for efficient HMF electrooxidation?
mechanism_or_method: Template-free synthesis of SC-MHEO nanoplates giving 99.3% HMF conversion and 97.7% FDCA selectivity, coupled with nitrate reduction.
limitation: Lab-scale electrolysis; long-term stability and cost not addressed in abstract.
decision_relevance: none

object: hydrogel-based flexible sensors with lipid bilayer coating
problem: How can hydrogel sensors retain water under dynamic deformation without losing conductivity and flexibility?
mechanism_or_method: Adaptive lipid-integrated bilayer coating anchored with amphiphilic molecules; spare lipids migrate to the surface during deformation.
limitation: Long-term dynamic sensing durability beyond lab tests not detailed.
decision_relevance: none

problem: Can entropy engineering create unsaturated metal sites in UiO-66 to boost catalytic transfer hydrogenation?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize ZrHfCeSnTi HE-UiO-66 with lattice distortion and 322.4 umol/g coordination unsaturated sites, lowering hydrogen transfer barrier.
limitation: Single reaction class tested; catalyst recyclability and scalability not addressed in abstract.
decision_relevance: none

object: laser powder bed fusion melting regimes
problem: Can acoustic emission signatures detect conduction-keyhole regime transitions during laser melting?
mechanism_or_method: Operando synchrotron X-ray imaging synchronized with acoustic recording; a simple filtering algorithm predicts regimes at 100 microsecond resolution.
limitation: Thin-wall remelting at synchrotron; transfer to full builds and industrial machines unverified.
decision_relevance: Enables acoustic in-process monitoring to detect keyhole instability in LPBF.

problem: How can structural foams reach ultrahigh specific strength while remaining recyclable?
mechanism_or_method: Core-shell nanostructured liquid metals linked by metal-ligand coordination and hydrogen bonds, foamed at subzero temperatures, reprocessed with water.
limitation: Lab-scale foam samples; creep, fatigue and scale-up not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Offers recyclable lightweight foam option for structural applications.

object: orthogonally light- and magnetic-responsive photonic gels
problem: How can gels respond independently to light and magnetic fields without mutual interference?
mechanism_or_method: Semi-interpenetrating network of photoswitchable azobenzene organogelator and Fe3O4@SiO2 nanoparticles forming magnetically controlled photonic chains.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of smart windows and labels; durability and response speed not quantified.
decision_relevance: none

object: freestanding quasi-BCC gold and copper nanolattices
problem: Can nanolattices achieve strength above bulk with ultrahigh energy absorption at scalable production?
mechanism_or_method: Quasi-BCC nanolattices with 34 nm beams; finite element simulation shows nanobeam bending dominance, giving about 100 MJ/m3 absorption.
limitation: Nanoscale samples; macroscale scalability claimed but mechanical behavior at scale not shown.
decision_relevance: Informs lattice architecture choice for high energy absorption materials.
